{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
sales['revenue_numeric'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders only
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Check for any remaining QA orders (should be zero)
qa_in_completed = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99]
print('QA orders in completed set:', len(qa_in_completed))

# Compute mean revenue of completed orders
mean_revenue = completed_orders['revenue_numeric'].mean()

print(f'Mean revenue of completed orders: {mean_revenue:.2f}')"}
